description:
Customize the Jitsi Meet user interface for a healthcare context. Access the Jitsi Web Docker container and modify the English localization file (`main.json`) to change the following text:

1. Change the 'Join meeting' button text to **"Enter Consultation"**.
2. Change the name input placeholder text to **"Patient Name"**.

After modifying the file, refresh the browser at http://localhost:8080 to verify the changes and take a screenshot of the pre-join screen saving it to `/home/ga/Documents/custom_ui_evidence.png`.
